verdict.rationale: RevenueCat is a subscription and revenue platform, so syncing to a general ledger or ERP is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack documents no native QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite sync of invoices, payments or recognition entries. Scheduled data exports to cloud storage or email, webhooks and the REST API are adjacent building blocks that would still require the finance team to do its own integration or CSV work, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery
